ELECTRICITY RULES, 1937
ELECTRICITY RULES,
1937
(Procedure
for the grant of permits to wiremen)
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, Part I, 12th
January, 2005]
No.SO(POWER)(I&P) 802/2001.LB.MNT, dated 18-10-2004.---In pursuance
of rule 48 of Electricity Rules, 1937 the Governor of Punjab is pleased to
notify the following procedure for issuance of permit to Wireman by Regional
Licensing Boards in Punjab constituted,--vide
Notification No. SO (POWER) (I&P) 4-2/2002:
The following procedure shall be
adopted for the grant of permit to the wireman, by the Regional Licensing
Boards in Punjab:-‑
1. An applicant possessing
minimum one year certificate course in electric trade from any Government
Vocational Training Centre or Apprenticeship Training Institute/Centre or
possessing equivalent qualification from any Government Institutions as may be
determined by TEVTA shall be granted a permit for wireman in a form attached as
Annex. W.
2. The applicant shall submit -application to
the Electric Inspector/Secretary Regional Licensing Board along with the
following attachments;
(i) Attested copy of certificate.
(ii) Attested
copy of N.I.C.
(iii) Attested
copies of three passport size recent photographs.
3. Secretary Licensing Board shall get a
verification report of the certificate from issuing authority and place the
case before the Board for consideration.
4. Validity.--The permit for
wireman shall be valid for four (4) years and will be renewed by the concerned
Secretary Regional Licensing Board. The Secretary Licensing Board shall
maintain an up-to-date "Grant & Renewal Record".
5. Duplicate Certificate.--A duplicate permit of wireman shall be
issued in case the original permit is lost or destroyed or defaced, subject to
submission of following documents with the written request of applicant:
(i) Press clipping regarding advertisement in newspaper.
(ii) Affidavit
on judicial stamp paper of Rs.20/-- to the effect that the original has been lost/destroyed and if the original is found subsequently,
the same shall be returned to the Secretary Licensing Board.
(iii) Copy of
FIR with police authority regarding loss of permit.
(iv) Original permit, if damaged/defaced.
Wireman is required to carry out
wiring works under the supervision of a person holding certificate of
competency granted under Rule 48 of the Electricity Rules, 1937 and is
responsible for quality of work. Permit issued to a wireman may be withdrawn or
suspended by the , Regional Licensing Board, if he is
adjudged guilty of misconduct and malpractice in discharge of his duties doing
his attachment with a licensed Electrical Contractor.
